field: 4-bit values represented by integers 0..15; addition is XOR

definitions.DDT: DDT(gamma, theta) = #{x : S(x) XOR S(x XOR gamma) = theta}
definitions.boomerang_return: R(x,gamma,delta) holds iff Sinv(S(x) XOR delta) XOR Sinv(S(x XOR gamma) XOR delta) = gamma
definitions.UBCT: UBCT(gamma, theta, delta) = #{x : R(x,gamma,delta) and S(x) XOR S(x XOR gamma) = theta}
definitions.LBCT: LBCT(gamma, lambda, delta) = #{x : R(x,gamma,delta) and x XOR Sinv(S(x) XOR delta) = lambda}
definitions.FBCT: FBCT(gamma, theta, lambda, delta) = #{x : R(x,gamma,delta), S(x) XOR S(x XOR gamma) = theta, and x XOR Sinv(S(x) XOR delta) = lambda}

normalization: Every DDT/BCT/UBCT/LBCT/FBCT factor in factor_graph.json is its integer count divided by 16.
naming_note: FBCT denotes the fully specified four-argument extended boomerang connectivity table; it is not the unrelated Feistel FBCT.
